summary: Keep desktop Markdown code-block copy controls stable, accessible, and independent of provider event timing.

reactNativeIos.reason: apps/mobile uses its own React Native Markdown block parser and native View/Text code-block renderer; it does not share the desktop Marked renderer or expose the affected copy-control contract.

nativeAndroid.reason: ThreadRichTextRenderer.kt renders code blocks with Compose primitives and does not share the desktop Marked renderer or its copy controls; the separate Android tool-summary density issue is outside this fix.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The fix consumes existing normalized content, status, error, and turn.completed events in renderer-local transient state without changing the runtime-event wire contract or coalescer ordering contract.

storageDataMigration.reason: Mutable/settled message state is transient renderer state; persisted and historical messages default to settled, so no database field, migration, or upgrade conversion is required.

updateRelease.reason: This is an unconditional desktop renderer bug fix with no feature flag, package identity, signing, deep-link, update-channel, release-packaging, or rollout compatibility change.

notExercised: Live Claude, Codex, and OpenCode streaming was not exercised because the existing Switchboard instance has active user sessions and the single-instance lock prevents isolated manual verification without disrupting them; normalized cumulative, delta, completion, tool/status, error, and interruption sequences are covered by automated tests.
Keyboard, coarse-pointer, and denied-clipboard behavior is covered at the renderer/component contract level but was not exercised on physical desktop or touch hardware in this worktree.
React Native/iOS and native Android hardware verification is not applicable because neither surface shares this renderer or copy-control contract.
